walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Food Technology specification.

Becoming a Discerning Consumer of Food appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Becoming a Discerning Consumer of Food in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Becoming a Discerning Consumer of Food.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
